primary_estimand: target-mix-weighted mean of item-level subagent-subagent minus API-API exact agreement, using all independent within-item coder pairs
secondary_estimands: target-mix-weighted mean of item-level API-subagent minus API-API exact agreement (AS_minus_AA)
target-mix-weighted mean of the route-shift term AA + SS - 2*AS (route_shift)
per-route validity rates and agreement conditional on both codings valid

families.construct: Code whether a supplied judicial-opinion passage substantively performs a specified legal or interpretive act.
families.fresh_method: Use newly filed opinions or original quote-verifiable passages with positive cases, mentions without analysis, attributed arguments, and true absences.

families.construct: Classify the principal interpretive move made by a supplied opinion passage under a frozen codebook.
families.fresh_method: Use newly filed or original passages representing text, purpose, legislative history, attributed reporting, hard negatives, and codebook edges.

families.construct: Extract an expressly stated legal term, date, threshold, actor, amount, count, or other value from supplied text using item-specific closed candidates.
families.allowed_label_pattern: item-specific closed candidate strings plus UNCERTAIN
families.fresh_method: Use post-cutoff minimized judicial materials and original legal sentences with one explicit target and plausible nearby distractors.

families.construct: Code whether a contract clause itself has a specified legal attribute or effect.
families.fresh_method: Use new original clauses or post-cutoff public clauses with positive cases, hard negatives, cross-references, and incomplete excerpts.

families.construct: Map a judicial filing or excerpt to its functional role in the record.
families.fresh_method: Use post-cutoff minimized motions, petitions, declarations, proposed orders, entered orders, and administrative records.

families.construct: Code whether a specified proposition is consistent across, contradicted by, or unrelated to two supplied judicial documents.
families.fresh_method: Use post-cutoff minimized filing packets with pre-adjudicated amount, request/order, allegation/evidence, and disposition relationships.

families.construct: Determine whether an assertion follows from a supplied rule and facts.
families.fresh_method: Instantiate new names, dates, thresholds, exceptions, and assertions from executable rule templates.

families.construct: Apply a supplied rule to facts where ordinary meaning and stated purpose may align or conflict.
families.fresh_method: Use familiar structures only as contamination sentinels; write new surface domains and vocabulary for confirmatory items.
